units.source_text: 母亲看着我，很为难的说：

en.t: Mother looked at me and said with great difficulty:

units.source_text: “现在我身体不好，全家都靠你爸爸一个人照顾，你要听话。

en.t: “I am not well now, and the whole family depends on your father alone to look after us, so you must be obedient.

units.source_text: 隔壁家的女儿经常去看戏，你也跟着一起……”

en.t: The daughter next door often goes to see plays, so you should go along with her too...”
